UK Mayor Burnham to Meet Trump, Discuss Ukraine Aid

Mayor of Greater Manchester, Andy Burnham, is scheduled to meet with former US President Donald Trump in September. Burnham plans to use the meeting to advocate for continued US support for Ukraine. He has previously described Trump as 'poisonous' but defended his decision to meet, stating the importance of the issue. The visit is also intended to push for further US support for Ukraine.
